root.label: Allocators and pmr
root.note: An allocator is a handle to a memory source; equal handles can free each other's memory.

children.label: Allocator model
children.note: Containers reach allocators only through allocator_traits.

children.label: Minimal allocator
children.note: value_type, allocate, deallocate, == and a converting constructor are enough.

children.label: Traits defaults
children.note: construct, destroy, pointer, max_size and is_always_equal = is_empty come from traits.

children.label: Rebind
children.note: Node containers allocate nodes through rebind_alloc; rebound copies must compare equal.

children.label: Propagation traits
children.note: Decide whether the allocator follows the elements on copy, move and swap.

children.label: Copy construction
children.note: Uses select_on_container_copy_construction of the source's allocator.

children.label: POCMA false, unequal
children.note: Move assignment allocates and moves elements one by one, so it may throw.

children.label: POCS false, unequal
children.note: swap is undefined behavior; there is no element-wise fallback.

children.label: Move construction
children.note: Always moves the allocator and adopts the buffer; it is noexcept.

children.label: polymorphic_allocator
children.note: Stores a memory_resource* and forwards to its virtual interface.

children.label: memory_resource
children.note: Public allocate, deallocate, is_equal call private virtual do_ functions.

children.label: Never propagates
children.note: POCCA, POCMA and POCS are all false, so a container keeps its resource.

children.label: Copies use default
children.note: Copy construction picks get_default_resource(), not the source's resource.

children.label: Not nothrow move-assign
children.note: pmr::vector move assignment is noexcept(false) because resources may differ.

children.label: Standard resources
children.note: Two global resources and three resource classes ship with the library.

children.label: new_delete_resource
children.note: Uses ::operator new; it is the initial default resource.

children.label: null_memory_resource
children.note: Throws bad_alloc on every allocation; an upstream that forbids fallback.

children.label: monotonic_buffer_resource
children.note: Bump allocation; deallocate is a no-op until release() or destruction.

children.label: Pool resources
children.note: Reuse fixed-size blocks; the synchronized version is thread-safe.

children.label: Uses-allocator construction
children.note: Passes the container's allocator down to elements that accept one.

children.label: Opting in
children.note: uses_allocator, via nested allocator_type, plus a trailing or allocator_arg-led parameter.

children.label: pmr does it
children.note: polymorphic_allocator::construct makes nested pmr strings share the outer resource.

children.label: scoped_allocator_adaptor
children.note: C++11 adaptor that performs the same protocol for other allocators.

children.label: allocate_at_least
children.note: C++23: allocator_traits returns {ptr, count} with count >= n.

children.label: Fallback
children.note: Without a member, traits return {allocate(n), n}.

children.label: Deallocate size
children.note: Pass a size between the requested n and the returned count.
